headline: The lamp stays on against the window.
body: Morning is already in the glass, and still no one reaches for the switch. A kettle clicks past the stair, then stops. We leave the margin blank for the hour that has not written itself.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: high pale blue, thin cloud over the chimney

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: desk lamp on against a full window

pulses.label: Watch
pulses.value: kettle click, then the stair goes quiet
